whereToFindEnabled.description: Opt in before this org's Offers can appear in "Where to Find" results (Deel 16 §44-45).

discoverable.description: Set false to stay hidden from partner-search (direct invitations still work) (Deel 15 §26).

ecosystemRoles.description: Deel 15 §7 — an org may hold multiple roles at once.
